data.action: 矮桌旁核对完花束预算合上家计簿，向镜头露出没有超支的满足笑
data.description: 【白银家公寓客厅·清晨】圭穿着简洁的银白婚纱坐在矮桌前，旁边仍放着她整理过的家计簿与一束便宜但新鲜的小花；她核对完最后一笔预算，才抬眼向镜头露出“这次没有超支”的满足笑。
data.lighting: gentle morning light across the low table
data.mood: 把精打细算也变成花嫁幸福
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane sits at the apartment's low table in a simple silver-white bridal dress and modest veil, finishing the last entry in the household budget. A small fresh bouquet rests beside the ledger. She looks up with satisfaction beneath her black ribbon headband. The vertical medium-full view keeps the dress folds and table together; gentle morning light brightens the ledger and flowers, with soft shadows beneath the bouquet stems.
data.title: 白银圭 · 预算表旁的银色花嫁
